description: Plaatselijke hoofdstukken en bestaande beelden gelezen en bekeken; nieuwe resultaten gecontroleerd op inhoud, anatomie en leesbaarheid.

images.alt: Vergelijking: goud en zilver beproeven — 1 Meqabyan 34:17; tekstillustratie.
images.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Photorealistic illustration for 1 Meqabyan, ancient Near East, landscape 3:2, natural materials, modest opaque fully covering clothing, coherent human anatomy exactly two arms and natural hands. No readable writing, modern objects, portrait of God, blood, wounds or corpses. A modestly robed ancient metalworker holding tongs over a small stone furnace, two small separate crucibles containing gold and silver on the hearth, safe controlled fire, no bodies or punishment. Photorealistic concrete comparison for testing deeds as gold and silver in fire in 1 Meqabyan 34:17–18, not a depiction of people burning.
